subject: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@leafhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-08T15:02:00Z
Subject: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth

Hi Tom — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps on the security intake so we can get you a prefilled SIG and a short evidence bundle for your InfoSec team:

- Redwood basics: SOC 2 Type II in scope (we'll attach the summary and relevant control mapping).
- Primary clarification we need from you: do you require customer-managed keys (CMK) / HSM for PHI? If yes, we'll scope a separate data residency/KMS flow.
- Are you looking for CAIQ or a fully-custom SIG? From our conversation it sounded like you wanted SIG with a couple custom items around data residency and retention.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach our SOC 2 summary + a dataflow diagram for the LeafHealth team to review (by EOD).
2) Please confirm whether PHI will be stored or only transited during inference. That will determine HIPAA control mapping.
3) If you want SIG + custom fields, confirm the two custom asks you mentioned (retention policy window and customer KMS) so we can prefill.

If you prefer, we can start with CAIQ prefill while we triage the custom items — that’s faster.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), redwood-dataflow-diagram.png (image)
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@leafhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-08T16:18:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth

Thanks David — good session. A few clarifying points from our security team:

- We will be passing PHI (hashed identifiers and some diagnostic notes) into the model. We do not expect long-term storage currently, but retention policy matters for audit.
- LeafHealth requires customer-managed keys for any persisted PHI. Transit-only is fine without CMK but we expect the option to enable CMK when/if persistence is enabled.
- Our InfoSec prefers SIG but will accept CAIQ if the SIG custom fields are clearly answered. Prefer SIG so the auditor can see vendor responses inline.

Action items for you: please confirm whether Redwood supports KMS/HSM options for private deployments and whether the SOC 2 mapping we’ll get includes HIPAA-relevant controls. Also can you provide an estimated time to deliver a prefilled SIG + evidence bundle?

-Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Security Programs, LeafHealth
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-08T16:35:00Z
Subject: Fwd: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth

Looping you both in — LeafHealth will pass PHI (transit now, possible persisted later) and they require CMK/HSM for persisted PHI. They prefer SIG with two custom fields: retention policy window & KMS/HSM support.

Karthik — can you confirm whether private deployment supports customer-managed keys and what evidence we can provide for the SOC2/HIPAA mapping?
Laura — can you assemble the standard evidence bundle and let me know if we need a short call with the auditor team to extract anything not in the public SOC2 summary?

Goal: send Tom a prefilled SIG + evidence bundle tomorrow morning if possible.

-David
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@leafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth

Hi team / Tom — short answers and action plan:

- CMK/HSM: Yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys through KMS integrations (GCP KMS, AWS KMS, and an HSM-backed option for on-prem). I’ll attach a short ops note.
- SOC2/HIPAA mapping: Our SOC 2 Type II covers infrastructure and control design. We maintain a HIPAA mapping doc that references which SOC 2 controls align to HIPAA administrative/physical/technical safeguards.
- Evidence: Laura will attach the SOC2 summary + the HIPAA mapping extract. For SIG prefill we can do CAIQ fields first and then populate custom SIG items inline.

Tom — provisional ETA: prefilled SIG draft + evidence bundle by 2027-06-09 11:00 AM PT (I've asked the security ops team to prioritize). If you need it sooner, flag and we’ll shift resources.

Attachments: redwood-kms-ops-note.pdf (ops note).

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@leafhealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-09T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth

Tom — attaching the prefill and the evidence bundle we discussed. Highlights below and a few clarifying asks inside the attached prefill document.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-dataflow-diagram.png, redwood-hipaa-mapping-extract.pdf, redwood-sig-prefill-draft.xlsx

Quick highlights:
- SOC 2 Type II: reporting period 2026-07 — 2027-06; control exceptions: none reported this period. (See summary).
- KMS: Private deploy supports CMK; public-hosted API offers envelope encryption but not CMK per-tenant.
- Retention: Default service retention is 30 days for logs/metrics; for persisted payloads retention is configurable by the customer in Private deployments — the prefill asks you to confirm desired retention window.

Clarifying asks inside the prefill (two quick ticks):
1) Desired retention window if you plan to persist PHI (e.g., 90 days / 1 year / custom).
2) For CMK, confirm provider (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, on-prem HSM) so we can document key rotation and access controls.

If those two items are quick for you, we can finalize the SIG responses and send the bundle to your auditor.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@leafhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-09T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence path — LeafHealth

Thanks all — received the bundle and the prefill. We’ll review internally and confirm retention (likely 90 days) and provider (likely AWS KMS). If anything else comes up I’ll reach out. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Tom
